verdict.rationale: The 01 is a voice-driven agent platform, so phone control is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence, however, only shows the Android & iOS apps as voice clients that capture and play back audio, while the server runs on your computer. Nothing documents the agent tapping, swiping or typing on a real phone, and the generic "control third-party software" claim is computer-side, so it does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a power user, the agent operates a real phone (tap, swipe, type) to finish a task I describe in plain language
